title: Manifold constrained steepest descent for smooth and closed-set optimization
abstract: arXiv:2601.21487v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study minimization of smooth functions over feasible sets that have smooth embedded-manifold structure throughout or only on selected regions, using linear minimization oracles (LMOs) to determine search directions under user-chosen norms. Restricting an LMO to a tangent space, however, can require an iterative inner solve. We propose \emph{Manifold Constrained Steepest Descent} (MCSD) and a tangent-projected variant, MCSD-TP, which avoid solving tangent-space LMO subproblems iteratively. The spectral-norm specialization of MCSD on the Stiefel manifold yields \emph{SPEL}, which admits an efficient implementation using matrix-sign computations. Under standard regularity assumptions, both methods attain an \(O(\log T/\sqrt T)\) best-iterate stationarity bound. translated_title: 流形约束下的最速下降法用于光滑与闭集优化
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在可行集上最小化光滑函数的问题，这些可行集要么整体具有光滑嵌入流形结构，要么仅在选定区域具有该结构，我们使用线性最小化预言机（LMOs）在用户选择的范数下确定搜索方向。然而，将LMO限制到切空间可能需要迭代的内部求解。我们提出了流形约束最速下降法（MCSD）及其切投影变体MCSD-TP，这两种方法避免了迭代求解切空间LMO子问题。在Stiefel流形上，MCSD的谱范数特化形式SPEL可通过矩阵符号计算实现高效求解。在标准正则性假设下，两种方法均达到\(O(\log T/\sqrt T)\)的最佳迭代平稳性界。对于闭可行集，混合MCSD--PGD方法将任一光滑方法与投影梯度下降相结合；在相应的局部光滑性条件下，每个...
tldr: 提出了一种无需迭代内层求解的流形约束最速下降法及其变体，在Stiefel流形上实现高效谱范数特化，并获得最优迭代收敛保证。
en_tdlr: We propose manifold constrained steepest descent methods that avoid iterative tangent-space subproblem solves, achieving efficient spectral-norm specialization on Stiefel manifolds with optimal iterate convergence guarantees.
